name: motion-duration-by-size
title: Duration by Size
description: Bài học: vật càng lớn chạy càng lâu; công tắc 150 ms, hộp thoại 350 ms, vai chính 700 ms.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Three squares (28 / 60 / 108 px) pop scale 0 → 1 together from 300 ms in 150 / 350 / 700 ms expo.out, labelled; they shrink away in 200 ms at 2000 ms. Rule: micro 100–200 ms, panels and modals 200–400 ms, full-screen / hero 400–800 ms; one duration for all makes big things look light. Params: small (0.15 s) · medium (0.35 s) · large (0.7 s). Rule: micro 0.1–0.2 s, panels and modals 0.2–0.4 s, full-screen or hero 0.4–0.8 s; one duration for all makes big things look light.
